name: surface-view-stop
description: A view surface declares its composition, the host reports that the view stopped its restarts, and the surface is mounted again and declares its composition again.
reason: The view calls reach the page as the notice view-call of a view that the host runs in a window, which the Go producer does not run (docs/spec/cases/page-wire/README.md#producer-runs).

payload.reason: the view failed 4 times within 300 seconds and is created again when its tab is reopened
